label: GB-equality-act-2010 Section 151

obligations.text:
(6)
On the first exercise of the power under subsection (5) to add an entry relating to a cross-border Welsh or Scottish authority to Schedule 19, a Minister of the Crown must—
(a)
add a Part 4 to the Schedule for cross-border authorities, and
(b)
add the cross-border Welsh or Scottish authority to that Part.

(7)
Any subsequent exercise of the power under subsection (5) to add an entry relating to a cross-border Welsh or Scottish authority to Schedule 19 must add that entry to Part 4 of the Schedule.
